dataset_metadata.title: Data from: Ultra-wideband radar to measure in vivo muscle forces

joint_torque.instrument: Biodex System 4 Pro Isokinetic Dynamometer (500 Hz) / Forsentek F3F 3-axis load cell (40 Hz)
joint_torque.biomechanical_relationship: Net rotational moment around joint axis: T_joint = T_agonists - T_antagonists + T_passive. It is NOT the force of an individual muscle.
critical_caveats: Cannot be directly equated to vastus lateralis muscle force
Conflates load-sharing among all four quadriceps heads (VL, VM, VI, RF)
Tendon moment arm d_MA(theta) varies continuously with knee flexion angle (from ~3.5 cm at 90 deg to ~4.8 cm at 20 deg)
Antagonist co-activation of hamstrings is present and opposes knee extension torque

joint_angle.units: degrees (0 deg = full extension, 90 deg = flexion)
joint_angle.biomechanical_relationship: Defines muscle-tendon unit length L_MTU(theta) and moment arm d_MA(theta)

joint_angular_velocity.units: deg/s (positive for extension, negative for flexion)

surface_electromyography.instrument: Bipolar surface electrodes over vastus lateralis belly (2048 Hz)
surface_electromyography.processing_pipeline: Bandpass filtered, rectified, low-pass smoothed, normalized to peak MVC amplitude
critical_caveats: Represents spatial average of superficial motor unit action potentials under electrode footprint
Subject to amplitude cancellation and tissue filtering (subcutaneous fat)
Under fatigue, increases by +26% +/- 15% for the exact same mechanical torque output (decoupling)
Does NOT measure intracellular ATP, PCr, or glycogen stores

fascicle_length.units: mm or strain relative to resting length [L / L_rest]
fascicle_length.instrument: Telemed ArtUs B-mode ultrasound (100 Hz, LV8-5N60-A2 transducer)
fascicle_length.processing_pipeline: UltraTrack v5.0 semi-automated optical flow fascicle tracking, 5 Hz low-pass filter
fascicle_length.biomechanical_relationship: Determines contractile operating point on actin-myosin overlap force-length curve f_L(L)

fascicle_velocity.instrument: Numerical time-derivative of ultrasound-tracked fascicle length
fascicle_velocity.biomechanical_relationship: Determines contractile operating point on Hill hyperbolic force-velocity curve f_V(v)

pennation_angle.units: degrees (angle between fascicle line and deep aponeurosis)
pennation_angle.instrument: Telemed B-mode ultrasound and UltraTrack v5.0
pennation_angle.biomechanical_relationship: Resolves fascicle force along tendon line of action: F_tendon = F_fascicle * cos(alpha)

radar_scattering_parameters.units: complex reflection and transmission coefficients (magnitude in dB, phase in radians)
radar_scattering_parameters.instrument: Vector Network Analyzer (VNA) with body-coupled UWB antenna (100 MHz to 2.9 GHz, 51 frequencies, 10.8 Hz)
radar_scattering_parameters.biomechanical_relationship: Tracks electromagnetic dielectric and geometric shifts of contracting tissue under antenna footprint
critical_caveats: Requires participant-specific machine learning (LSTM or LME) calibration
Does not provide physical force in Newtons without dynamometer ground-truth training
Correlates with muscle force even when EMG and fascicle length decouple under fatigue
Direct measurement requires invasive buckle transducers or optic fiber tendon probes (prohibited on human subjects in vivo)
Approximating F_VL = T_joint / d_MA ignores vastus medialis, vastus intermedius, rectus femoris load-sharing and hamstring co-contraction
Evidence Gate V2 strictly forbids presenting uncalibrated model inferences as measured Newtons

isokinetic_force_velocity_decay.decay_mechanism: Concentric cross-bridge detachment kinetics; torque drops by ~34% from 30 deg/s to 120 deg/s

M0_constant_baseline.name: M0 Constant Mean Torque Baseline
M0_constant_baseline.description: Predicts mean dynamic torque across all conditions

M1_static_semg_activation.name: M1 Static sEMG Activation Model [T = k * a]
M1_static_semg_activation.description: Fails during passive movements and high-velocity isokinetic contractions due to activation-force decoupling

M2_static_length_tension.name: M2 Static Fascicle Length-Tension Model [T = f(L_fas)]
M2_static_length_tension.description: Fails because fascicle length changes during passive rotations with zero active torque

M3_hill_type_dynamic.name: M3 Classical Hill Force-Length-Velocity Model [T = a * f_L(L) * f_V(v) * T0]
M3_hill_type_dynamic.description: Substantially improves over static models by accounting for concentric force-velocity drop, but omits angle-dependent moment arm and serial compliance

M4_subject01_biomechanical.name: M4 SUBJECT-01 Multiscale Architecture [T = (a * f_L * f_V * cos(alpha) + f_P) * d_MA(theta) * M_scale]
M4_subject01_biomechanical.description: Integrates dynamic fascicle kinetics, variable moment arm d_MA(theta), pennation angle resolution, and mass allometry

stage3_dynamic_contraction_mechanics.epistemic_warning: With N=6 participants in Dynamic Knee, confidence intervals are necessarily wide ([0.68, 0.81]). Evidence from vastus lateralis knee extension CANNOT be extrapolated to whole-body maximum strength or other muscle groups.

stage4_fatigue_and_recovery.contraction_mode: Intermittent isometric knee extensions (trapezoidal pulses 8% to 45% MVC)

M0_constant_capacity.name: M0 Constant Capacity (Zero Fatigue)
M0_constant_capacity.verdict: REJECTED: completely fails to account for neuromuscular fatigue and force-activation decoupling

M1_phenomenological_linear_drift.name: M1 Phenomenological Linear Drift Model
M1_phenomenological_linear_drift.verdict: EMPIRICALLY_FITTED: captures average cohort drift but lacks biophysical mechanism for individual variation

M2_subject01_biophysical_fatigue.name: M2 SUBJECT-01 Biophysical Fatigue Mechanism (E_reserve + Pi + Ca2+ Uncoupling)
M2_subject01_biophysical_fatigue.verdict: VALIDATED_ON_ISOMETRIC_FATIGUE_COHORT: reproduces non-linear fatigue onset and inter-individual resistance

epistemic_boundaries.emg_is_not_pcr_atp: Surface EMG activation drift reflects neural compensation for peripheral cross-bridge failure, NOT direct measurement of intracellular PCr or ATP.
epistemic_boundaries.protocol_does_not_validate_cpe45: A 20-minute intermittent submaximal knee extension protocol (8-45% MVC) DOES NOT validate TARGET-CPE45 (which requires 45 minutes of whole-body locomotive critical power).

stage5_multiscale_model_bridge.synchronous_experiment_claim: STRICTLY_PROHIBITED (Collected on distinct cohorts, distinct instruments, distinct tasks)

neural_drive_to_mechanics.input: Motor unit action potential train / sEMG proxy a(t)
neural_drive_to_mechanics.transfer_function: Excitation-contraction coupling -> Ca2+ release -> cross-bridge attachment -> active tension

mechanics_to_metabolism.input: Mechanical cross-bridge work rate P_chem(t) = F_muscle * v_fas / eta_muscle
mechanics_to_metabolism.observed_in: Bird 2026 (fascicle velocity v_fas, pennation alpha, joint torque T)
mechanics_to_metabolism.transfer_function: ATP hydrolysis rate J_ATP(t) = P_chem(t) / Delta_G_ATP
mechanics_to_metabolism.boundary_limits: Tendon moment arm d_MA(theta) and multi-muscle load sharing unobserved directly

metabolism_to_local_phosphates.observed_in: Rehman 2024 (31P-MRS PCr recovery tau=39.4 s, k=1.53 min^-1)
metabolism_to_local_phosphates.transfer_function: Creatine kinase equilibrium: ADP + PCr + H+ <-> ATP + Cr; oxidative replenishment tau_PCr
metabolism_to_local_phosphates.boundary_limits: Calibrated on single human subject (N=1); intracellular pH dynamics must be accounted for

local_phosphates_to_systemic_vo2.observed_in: ACTES 2026 (N=18 cycling CPET) and Malaga 2026 (N=846 treadmill CPET)
local_phosphates_to_systemic_vo2.transfer_function: First-order cardiorespiratory ODE: tau_VO2 * dVO2/dt + VO2 = VO2_ss(P); tau = 35.0 s
local_phosphates_to_systemic_vo2.boundary_limits: Lagged by circulatory transit time (~20..35 s); delta efficiency not identifiable from unlagged ramp

indirectly_estimated: Individual muscle force (requires moment arm d_MA and load-sharing assumption)
Intracellular pH (derived from chemical shift difference delta_Pi - delta_PCr)
unidentifiable_open_barriers: True single-muscle in vivo mechanical power during locomotion
Absolute rest PCr concentration [PCr]_rest in mmol/kg
Synchronous joint-local-systemic coupling on a single human organism

stage6_augmentation_architectures.evaluation_standard: HUMAN EVIDENCE / COMPUTATIONAL INFERENCE / THEORETICAL POSSIBILITY / UNRESOLVED BARRIER

architecture_A_biological_enhancement.name: Architecture A: Biological Enhancement of Native Muscle
architecture_A_biological_enhancement.concept: In situ genetic/pharmacological hypertrophy, mitochondrial biogenesis, and tendon stiffening
human_evidence: Vastus lateralis force-length-velocity dynamics confirmed in Bird 2026
Neuromuscular fatigue causes +26% activation compensation under submaximal load (Bird 2026)
Pulmonary oxygen kinetics governed by first-order ODE tau=35s (ACTES/Malaga)
computational_inference: A 20% increase in physiological cross-sectional area (PCSA) can produce +20% isometric force at optimal length
However, increased fiber diameter increases oxygen diffusion distance from capillaries to mitochondria
architecture_A_biological_enhancement.theoretical_possibility: High biological feasibility; maintains native innervation, proprioception, and joint articulation
unresolved_barriers: UNRESOLVED_BARRIER: Hypertrophy increases muscle mass and metabolic maintenance cost in non-active states
UNRESOLVED_BARRIER: Tendon strain limits: native patellar tendon safety margin reduced under +20% peak force
UNRESOLVED_BARRIER: TARGET-CPE45 requires extreme oxidative endurance; hypertrophy often shifts toward glycolytic Type IIx fibers, accelerating fatigue

architecture_B_supplemental_muscle.name: Architecture B: Supplemental Implanted Bioengineered Muscle
architecture_B_supplemental_muscle.concept: Surgically placed parallel biological muscle graft sharing load with native quadriceps
human_evidence: Bird 2026 confirms that load sharing among knee extensors cannot be directly controlled or observed by joint dynamometry
Ultrasound demonstrates tight spatial constraints over vastus lateralis belly (2 of 8 participants excluded due to lack of skin space)
computational_inference: Placing a secondary muscle requires dedicated anatomical compartment space
Vascular perfusion: requires microvascular anastomosis supplying >= 1.5 L/min blood flow during peak exertion
architecture_B_supplemental_muscle.theoretical_possibility: Moderate biological feasibility; reduces native muscle fatigue by load sharing
unresolved_barriers: UNRESOLVED_BARRIER: Neuromuscular reinnervation: motor axon sprouting and functional motor unit recruitment
UNRESOLVED_BARRIER: Mechanical tendon integration: anchoring artificial tendon to patella without avulsion fracture
UNRESOLVED_BARRIER: Spatial crowding: vastus lateralis compartment has strict volumetric boundaries

architecture_C_biohybrid_actuator.name: Architecture C: Fully Internal Biohybrid Actuator
architecture_C_biohybrid_actuator.concept: Synthetic carbon-nanotube/elastomer scaffold seeded with contractile muscle cells and artificial tendon
human_evidence: Bird 2026 shows that biological fascicles exhibit complex non-linear strain-rate dependent damping
Radar signals detect frequency-dependent electromagnetic impedance changes during cross-bridge cycling
computational_inference: Biohybrid actuators could theoretically exceed biological specific tension (30 N/cm2 -> 50+ N/cm2)
Could bypass biological excitation-contraction fatigue mechanisms
architecture_C_biohybrid_actuator.theoretical_possibility: Long-term theoretical possibility; extreme engineering complexity
unresolved_barriers: UNRESOLVED_BARRIER: Immune rejection and chronic foreign-body capsule formation
UNRESOLVED_BARRIER: Nutrient and oxygen delivery in thick (>5 mm) engineered 3D muscle tissue without capillary bed
UNRESOLVED_BARRIER: Thermal dissipation: high-power contraction generates heat that cannot be dissipated internally without dedicated heat exchange

synthesis_comparison.recommended_focus: Architecture A (Biological Enhancement) remains the most grounded path with highest human evidence, but requires solving the Type I oxidative vs Type II force tradeoff to achieve both +20% force and TARGET-CPE45.
